proposedEvidenceCatalog.description: Exactly centered generator plus adjacent, correctly oriented A/B circulators on the same native grid.
Apc receiver must be powered; both sides need inlet-to-outlet pressure differential, gas and temperature contrast; electrical output is HV.
Ordinary pipe contacts require anchored same-grid reciprocal neighboring nodes with matching group and pipe layer.
Lattice is a nonempty tile with isSpace:true; anchoring support and a breathable room floor are independent properties.
AddToSnapGridCell rejects absent/empty tiles; floor_or_lattice support must be materialized on the intended native grid.
Heat exchange depends on containing gas/radiative background, and air-blocked placement suppresses processing; exposed vacuum has the CMB radiation background.
